## Why

What fails or is missing without this change.

## What changed

Per module, what changed and why it was done this way. Name the analogue in the Python SDK, the TypeScript SDK or core that it follows.

## How it was verified

The commands you ran and what they printed, such as `./mvnw clean verify` and the JDKs it ran on, the mutation checks and whether each was caught, and for a fix the test that fails without it. Say what was not run.

## Follow-ups

Each one filed as an issue and linked, or "None".

## Closes

`Closes #NN`. `main` is the default branch, so the issue is closed by hand once this merges into `develop`.
